notes: Flags: none (flat-pack, so F-22 does not apply). The page's Width row (63") cannot hold its own 76" mattress; the drawing's 79 1/8" is the King's width, and the rows look like the Queen's left on the King page. Fit (the king brief, master-bedroom): with the headboard on the right wall and the window-side edge at the bathroom door's landing (y 97), the frame's window-side edge falls at y 17.875, 11.875" from the heater's drawn face (F-33: 6" for furniture). The 76" mattress sits 1 9/16" in from each side rail, so its edge is 13.4" from the face (F-33: 12" for bedding). F-34: 17.875" on the window side, from the wall. That is 1/8" over the 79" the brief allows. 83 1/8" long, so it leaves 93 7/8" of the room's 177". Luröy slatted base included (the set's article 094.185.84; its URL carries the s). 3.9 stars (786). Assembly service $63.70. In stock in IKEA Long Island, NY; click and collect free; home delivery to our ZIP from $39.00 (2026-10-24). Sizes: Full $179.00, Queen $199.00 (ikea-29007794), King $249.00. rooms: master-bedroom, from the king brief.
